Container.Name: Pullarr
Container.Overview: Monitor western comic series, download missing issues, and organize CBZ/CBR files for Komga or Kavita.
Container.Description: Pullarr uses ComicVine metadata to monitor comic issues and can download missing issues from GetComics. It organizes CBZ/CBR files with ComicInfo.xml metadata and can connect to an optional qBittorrent client. Add a comics root folder and a ComicVine API key in Pullarr after installation.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent database, API key, and settings.

Config.Name: Comics
Config.Description: Comic library folder. Add /comics as a root folder in Pullarr after installation.
